digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler integration tests, binding state operations
propositions: The idempotency test patches _now_iso on binding_store but not on binding_lifecycle, so it no longer reaches clock calls in moved operations like clear_absent.
RP-02 S2 T2 moved absence/tombstone/comment operations from binding_store to binding_lifecycle, which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, bypassing the integration test's mock.
The test still passes and correctly asserts no-churn because the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but its ability to catch regressions in clear_absent and siblings is silently weakened.
Unit-tier coverage exists for clear_absent no-stamp contract, but the integration-tier oracle's blast radius narrowed and should be restored by patching both module clocks.

AC#2 premise is false: clear_absent is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window pass, so seeding an unconditional timestamp mutation cannot drive the integration test red without additional harness changes.
